title: Moonrizon pitch: choose the deck structure
question: The cover is the lunar horizon simulator in all three. Pick how the rest of the deck is built around it.

options.label: The annotated horizon
options.lineage: technical cutaway diagrams with numbered callouts
options.thesis: One horizon scene, taken apart slide by slide: ridge, Sun, Earth, timeline, ranking.
options.viewport: Full-bleed horizon at dawn, Sun and Earth at true size, title set in the dark sky, four callouts pinned to the scene.
options.risk: Callouts can crowd the scene if every slide labels too much.

options.label: The observatory log
options.thesis: Each slide is a log entry: site, UTC time, Sun and Earth readings beside a horizon strip.
options.viewport: Cover is the horizon scene with a log header: site name, date, Sun 2.1°, Earth 6.4°.
options.risk: Can read as a data sheet instead of a pitch if the readings take over.

options.label: Four strips, one ridge
options.thesis: The cover horizon starts as four mismatched strips, the four tools, and locks into one ridge that runs through every slide.
options.viewport: Four offset strips labelled QuickMap, Moon Trek, Horizons, portals align into one horizon with Sun and Earth above it.
options.risk: The stitch move needs motion to land; on a printed PDF it is a still.
